notes: Ran an unprotected R&D 3-4 times per turn on T1-T8; repeat runs saw the same top card, so roughly 17 clicks were wasted. Never ran Server 1, which held a single unrezzed ice: the Corp scored Longevity Serum T2, Fujii T6 (after 3 visible advances on T5) and the winning Longevity Serum T12 after the T11 install was left alone while the Runner installed Daily Casts/Docklands Pass. Sat on 5 credits all game and lost Sure Gambles to net damage instead of playing them.

Solid R&D pressure with Zahya and Marjanah; won by T11. Minor oddities: T6 Mutual Favor fetched a second Carmen while one was already installed (it was never played), Flip Switch was installed T2 and never used, and T3-T4 had some idle credit clicks at 8-10 credits.

T2-T3 ran R&D 4 times per turn at 1 credit, which repeated the same card. On T5 it ran 4 times into the known Hammer with no breaker and 1 credit, took 4 tags and then spent T6-T9 clicking to remove them. After Retribution trashed Buzzsaw it never installed another card. T12-T16 it only clicked for credits (up to 22) while the Corp advanced Servers 1/3/4; it did not contest Server 3 on T16 at 6-7 points and lost T17.

Won through HQ (Docklands Pass) and R&D steals with good econ. Ran into unbroken Vertigo every turn (T3-T14) and lost a click and sometimes the steal each time, without looking for a way to break it. Red Team was installed for 5 on T8 and never used. T12 left the 2-advanced Server 1 card alone (4 ice), and it scored as Méliès T13.

Good T2 double steal via Tremolo + Docklands Pass. T3, with only 4 cards and 4 credits, it facechecked a freshly iced Jinteki remote against a 16-credit Corp and was flatlined by Saisentan. Safer lines were installing the held Pennyshaver or re-running HQ through the known Tatu-Bola.

T1-T4 ran R&D 3-4 times per turn, repeating the same card. T7-T12 it only clicked for credits (up to 27) while holding 5 cards it never played. T15 it ran the Nico Campaign server three times into Ansel 1.0: it lost Carmen, then Cat's Cradle, reinstalled Cat's Cradle and lost it again, and could not trash Nico anyway. Meanwhile it ignored the fresh install in Server 1, which scored Project Ingatan for the win T16.

Good T4-T5 Boi-tatá breaks through Ballista for two Divested Trusts. After SDS trashed Boi-tatá (T7) it never rebuilt and clicked for credits on T9-T10 at 9-15 credits. It installed a second Leech and Mystic Maemi on T10 instead of contesting the 1-advanced Server 1 card while the Corp sat at 5 points; that card scored T11 for the loss. Buzzsaw was installed T2 and never used.

T2-T5 every click was an R&D run on an unprotected R&D that kept showing the same top card, with the grip stuck at 3 cards and 5 credits. It never played the Wildcat Strike, Gachapon or Paladin Poemu it held. Against Weyland at 5 points it stayed on 3 cards and was flatlined by Measured Response T6.

Good early HQ pressure, and T9 Burner plus a Unity break on Mestnichestvo stole Next Big Thing. It left Federal Fundraising untrashed on T5, then trashed its only breaker Unity to Spec Work on T10. It clicked for credits T7-T8 and T11-T13 (up to 23) while the Corp advanced Server 1 behind a lone Ping, and never contested Server 1 before the NBT score T12 or the winning Embedded Reporting T14.

Won with good remote and R&D steals (T4, T6, T7, T11). Card use was erratic: T2 Spec Work trashed Unity, which then needed Rigging Up T5 to get back; T10 Spec Work trashed Mantle; T11 Simulchip trashed Unity to fetch Echelon from the heap.

Strong start (paid through Grubber for NBT T1, PTD T2) and won T11. In between it ran into unbroken Unsmiling Tsarevna on R&D five times (T3, T7, T8, T10, T11), taking a tag and 2 net each time and losing Unity, Pantograph and Simulchip to the damage. T6 Spec Work trashed Self-modifying Code, and Unity was never installed.

Gachapon/Boi-tatá into an Above the Law steal T3 was fine. T5 it facechecked Akhet with 2 credits, and T7-T8 it clicked for credits while holding Paladin Poemu, Mystic Maemi, Fencer Fueno and Running Hot uninstalled. Against Weyland with 10+ credits, the successful T8 R&D run on 6 credits set up a double Measured Response flatline T9.

Never installed a single program and finished at 46 credits with 5 unplayed cards. It spent T3-T4, T6, T8 and T11-T14 clicking for credits, plus 3 repeat R&D runs on T9. It never answered Ping, and let NBT (Server 3, T8), Embedded Reporting (Server 4, T9) and the winning Tomorrow's Headline (Server 2, installed T14) score uncontested.

Excellent T1 (Shibboleth, Tread Lightly steal, Transfer of Wealth) and it eventually won T18. But T8-T11 it clicked for credits (up to 26) with 5 cards held. T12 it chose to continue through Karunā's first sub, took 4 net in total and then jacked out anyway; the untouched Server 4 card scored as Regenesis T14.

Sensible aggressive play vs Jinteki, and it won by spotting Fujii and Longevity Serum in Archives (T14-T15). Repeated runs through Anemone (T4, T5, T8, T12-T14) bled a card each time, including Shibboleth and Docklands Pass. The T10 jack-out after Saisentan on 2 cards was defensible, but it let Yagi-Uda score T11.

Installed Marjanah T1 and never played another card or drew all game. T2-T9 it ran R&D twice per turn through Vertigo, and the second run repeated the same card. T10-T14 it ran Server 1 into Ansel 1.0 nineteen times, although its 'cannot steal' subroutine blocked every steal. The Corp scored Méliès (T12), Ingatan (T13) and Ingatan (T15) from a server the Runner could not affect.

Good tempo: Gachapon into Buzzsaw, Raindrops HQ steal T1, and trading Buzzsaw for SDS T4, then winning T12. It survived Measured Response T5 at exactly 4 cards. T8 it spent its last 4 credits on Banner (later trashed by SDS, never used) instead of contesting the 1-advanced Server 1 card that scored T9. T10 it ran into the known Hammer at 1 credit.

Spent all 5 credits on Carmen T1, then T2-T13 ran R&D twice per turn through unbroken Vertigo; the second run repeated the same card and was usually blocked from stealing. It never drew or played its 3 held cards. With no answer to Hagen on Server 3, it watched Méliès score T7 and T11 and Architect Deployment Test win T14.

Clean HQ pressure with Docklands Pass and Zahya (steals T2, T8, T9) and good Carmen breaks of Ansel 1.0 on R&D, winning T9. Minor: Red Team was installed T5 at 5 credits leaving 1, and Cat's Cradle/Marjanah were barely used.

35 of 36 clicks were 'gain 1 credit', ending at 40 credits with 5 unplayed cards and no installs. The only run was a T4 Akhet facecheck. Weyland scored SDS (T6), Above the Law (T8) and Transport Monopoly (T10) from Server 1 with no further contest.
